FACSIMILE of the 柿架 leaf carrying the Qunfang Pu (1621) tomato entry.

Source Wikimedia Commons, File:CADAL06068181 御定駢字類編·卷一百九十七~卷一百九十八.djvu
Scanned by CADAL / Zhejiang University from the 欽定四庫全書 (Siku Quanshu)
recension. Commons licence: Public domain.
Page DJVU page 65 of 184 (the file covers juan 197-198)
Rendered server-side by Commons at 1600px; no local djvu tooling required
Retrieved 2026-08-30

WHAT THE LEAF SHOWS, read from the image:
Page header 欽定四庫全書; side column 御定駢字類編.
Headwords in sequence: 柿漆 / 柿陰 / 柿架 / 柿陂 — matching the Wikisource
transcription exactly.
Under 柿架:
群芳譜蕃柿一名六月丨 莖似蒿高四五尺 葉似艾 花似榴 一枝結五實或三四實
一樹二三十實 縛作丨最堪觀 火傘火珠未足為喻 草本也 來自西蕃故名
(丨 is the Pianzi Leibian's repeat mark standing for the headword character.)

THE CHARACTER QUESTION IS SETTLED. The printed form is 蕃 (with the grass
radical 艹), NOT 番 — both in 蕃柿 and in 來自西蕃故名. The Wikisource
transcription is correct on this point, and the distinction from the Taiwan
gazetteers' 番柿 (Diospyros discolor, the velvet apple) holds against the
facsimile.

This passage is therefore no longer transcription-only evidence.
